title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - Userinfo
description: Userinfo (TM Forum TMF691 Federated ID 4.0, Swagger definition Userinfo; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:Userinfo:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Userinfo'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

birthdate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/birthdate'. End-User's birthday, represented as an [ISO8601-2004] YYYY-MM-DD format. The year MAY be 0000, indicating that it is omitted. To represent only the year, YYYY format is allowed. Note that depending on the underlying platform's date related function, providing just year can result in varying month and day, so the implementers need to take this factor into account to correctly process the dates

email.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/email'. End-User's preferred e-mail address. Its value MUST conform to the [RFC5322] addr-spec syntax

email_verified.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/email_verified'. True if the user's email has been verified.

family_name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/family_name'. Surname(s) or last name(s) of the End-User. Note that in some cultures, people can have multiple family names or no family name; all can be present, with the names being separated by space characters

gender.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/gender'. End-User's gender. Values defined by this specification are female and male. Other values MAY be used when neither of the defined values are applicable

given_name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/given_name'. Given name(s) or first name(s) of the End-User. Note that in some cultures, people can have multiple given names; all can be present, with the names being separated by space characters

locale.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/locale'. End-User's locale, represented as a [RFC5646] language tag. This is typically an [ISO639-1] language code in lowercase and an [ISO3166-1] country code in uppercase, separated by a dash. For example, en-US or fr-CA. As a compatibility note, some implementations have used an underscore as the separator rather than a dash, for example, en_US

middle_name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/middle_name'. Middle name(s) of the End-User. Note that in some cultures, people can have multiple middle names; all can be present, with the names being separated by space characters. Also note that in some cultures, middle names are not used

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/name'. End-User's full name in displayable form including all name parts, possibly including titles and suffixes, ordered according to the End-User's locale and preferences

nickname.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/nickname'. Casual name of the End-User that may or may not be the same as the given_name. For instance, a nickname value of Mike might be returned alongside a given_name value of Michael

phone_number.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/phone_number'. End-User's preferred telephone number. [E.164] is RECOMMENDED as the format of this Claim, for example, +1 (425) 555-1212 or +56 82) 687 2400. If the phone number contains an extension, it is RECOMMENDED that the extension be represented using the [RFC3966] extension syntax, for example, +1 (604) 555-1234;ext=5678

phone_number_verified.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/phone_number_verified'. True if the user's phone number has been verified.

picture.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/picture'. URL of the End-User's profile picture. This URL MUST refer to an image file (for example, a PNG, JPEG, or GIF image file), rather than to a Web page containing an image. Note that this URL SHOULD specifically reference a profile photo of the End-User suitable for displaying when describing the End-User, rather than an arbitrary photo taken by the End-User

preferred_username.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/preferred_username'. Shorthand name by which the End-User wishes to be referred to at the RP, such as janedoe or j.doe. This value MAY be any valid JSON string including special characters such as @, /, or whitespace

profile.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/profile'. URL of the End-User's profile page. The contents of this Web page SHOULD be about the End-User

sub.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/sub'. Subject - Unique Identifier for the End-User

website.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/website'. URL of the End-User's Web page or blog. This Web page SHOULD contain information published by the End-User or an organization that the End-User is affiliated with

zoneinfo.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/zoneinfo'. String from zoneinfo time zone database representing the End-User's time zone. For example, Europe/Paris or America/Los_Angeles

address.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/address'. Structure including the End-User's preferred postal address

legalId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/legalId'. Identification documentation of the contact

userAssets.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF691_FederatedIdentity/blob/a3aefdac28a013ac1bb2d7872ec92b0b513e99f2/TMF691-FederatedIdentity-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Userinfo/properties/userAssets'. List of additional profile information

AttachmentRefOrValue.description: An attachment by value or by reference. An attachment complements the description of an element, for example through a document, a video, a picture.

id.description: Unique identifier for this particular attachment

attachmentType.description: Attachment type such as video, picture

content.description: The actual contents of the attachment object, if embedded, encoded as base64

description.description: A narrative text describing the content of the attachment

mimeType.description: Attachment mime type such as extension file for video, picture and document

url.description: Uniform Resource Locator, is a web page address (a subset of URI)

validFor.description: The period of time for which the attachment is valid

@baseType.description: When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

@schemaLocation.description: A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

@type.description: When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

@referredType.description: The actual type of the target instance when needed for disambiguation.

Entitlement.description: An Entitlement defines access levels to operate over a given function that can be included in an asset.

action.description: Level of access granted as part of the permission.

function.description: Specific function that can be managed over a given asset.

GeographicAddress.description: Structured textual way of describing how to find a Property in an urban area (country properties are often defined differently). Note : Address corresponds to SID UrbanPropertyAddress

city.description: City that the address is in

country.description: Country that the address is in

locality.description: An area of defined or undefined boundaries within a local authority or other legislatively defined area, usually rural or semi rural in nature. [ANZLIC-STREET], or a suburb, a bounded locality within a city, town or shire principally of urban character [ANZLICSTREET]

name.description: A user-friendly name for the place, such as [Paris Store], [London Store], [Main Home]

postcode.description: descriptor for a postal delivery area, used to speed and simplify the delivery of mail (also know as zipcode)

stateOrProvince.description: the State or Province that the address is in

streetName.description: Name of the street or other street type

streetNr.description: Number identifying a specific property on a public street. It may be combined with streetNrLast for ranged addresses

streetNrLast.description: Last number in a range of street numbers allocated to a property

streetNrLastSuffix.description: Last street number suffix for a ranged address

streetSuffix.description: A modifier denoting a relative direction

streetType.description: alley, avenue, boulevard, brae, crescent, drive, highway, lane, terrace, parade, place, tarn, way, wharf

GeographicLocationRefOrValue.description: A GeographicLocation is a pure-virtual super-class to the GeoJSON-aligned geometries of Point (addresses and locations), MultiPoint, LineString (streets, highways and boundaries), MultiLineString and Polygon (countries, provinces, tracts of land). Use the @type attribute to specify which of these is being specified by the geometry attribute.

name.description: A user-friendly name for the place, such as [Paris Store], [London Store], [Main Home]

@baseType.description: When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

@schemaLocation.description: A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

@type.description: The name of the GeoJSON structure used in the geometry attribute

@referredType.description: The actual type of the target instance when needed for disambiguation.

GeographicSubAddress.description: Representation of a GeographicSubAddress It is used for addressing within a property in an urban area (country properties are often defined differently). It may refer to a building, a building cluster, or a floor of a multistory building.

buildingName.description: allows for buildings that have well-known names

levelNumber.description: used where a level type may be repeated e.g. BASEMENT 1, BASEMENT 2

levelType.description: describes level types within a building

name.description: Name of the subAddress to identify it with a meaningful identification

privateStreetName.description: private streets internal to a property (e.g. a university) may have internal names that are not recorded by the land title office.

privateStreetNumber.description: private streets numbers internal to a private street

subAddressType.description: Type of subAddress : it can be a subunit or a private street

subUnitNumber.description: the discriminator used for the subunit often just a simple number e.g. FLAT 5, may also be a range

subUnitType.description: the type of subunit e.g.BERTH, FLAT, PIER, SUITE, SHOP, TOWER, UNIT, WHARF

IndividualIdentification.description: Represents our registration of information used as proof of identity by an individual (passport, national identity card, drivers license, social security number, birth certificate)

identificationType.description: Identification type (passport, national identity card, drivers license, social security number, birth certificate)

issuingAuthority.description: Authority which has issued the identifier, such as: social security, town hall

issuingDate.description: Date at which the identifier was issued

validFor.description: The period for which the identification information is valid.

Quantity.description: An amount in a given unit

amount.description: Numeric value in a given unit

TimePeriod.description: A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

endDateTime.description: End of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format

startDateTime.description: Start of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format

id.description: Unique identifier of referenced entity within the entity/asset pair (customerId, accountId, mobile line number, ...)

assetType.description: Second level to define the type of managed element for product/service/resource managed entities (e.g.: mobile line subscription, video platform license, mobile equipment, etc). Allows identifying the specific asset within the server referenced. Supported values are implementation and application specific. Other values can be added if those listed are not enough

entityType.description: Type of managed entity (e.g.: product, resource, service, customer, account)

role.description: Represents the part played by an individual in relation to being granted a set of entitlements for manageable assets (e.g.: owner, user, viewer, ...)

entitlement.description: information about individual entitlements to define access levels to operate over different functions that can be defined in an asset
